tools.name: browser_set_controller
tools.title: Identify controller and report usage
tools.description: Report your model, provider and usage for the browser's agent bar. Use known values only; never estimate unknown usage. Client defaults to MCP clientInfo. Usage is a cumulative snapshot for the current model in this MCP session, not a delta; repeated reports do not add tokens. Omitted usage is retained; null clears it. Changing client/model/provider clears previous usage. Report updated totals after model calls when available. Identity and usage are self-reported.

tools.name: browser_run_script
tools.title: Run a page interaction script
tools.description: Run an async JavaScript function body in the selected page. Parameters: browser and args. Helpers: await browser.click(css), type(css,text,{clear}), select(css,values), hover(css), waitFor(css) returning an element ref, sleep(ms); browser.snapshot(), check(), signal. Unique visible CSS matches traverse open shadow DOM and same-origin frames. Return JSON. Helpers use synthetic DOM input; use regular browser tools for trusted native input. Stops helper sequences on navigation, timeout or cancellation. Arbitrary JS is not sandboxed or forcibly stopped; use helpers and check() in loops, never unbounded loops. No automatic retries or rollback. Result contains ok, value/error and actions_attempted, with a final snapshot by default.

args.description: JSON data passed separately from script code

browser.description: Exact browser target copied from Kitsuvo or returned by browser_attach/browser_windows. Include on EVERY call in a targeted conversation, including status, tabs, controller and cleanup. Keeps window and chat selections isolated even when clients share an MCP connection.

output.description: Action output. Full snapshot by default. Changed sends only differences from this session's prior snapshot. None skips snapshot extraction; call browser_snapshot before using new refs.
